name: HENNES + MAURITZ B SK-125
summary: H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB (publ) functions as an international retail enterprise offering clothing, accessories, footwear, beauty products, and home furnishings marketed through brands including H&M, COS, Monki, Weekday, and ARKET. H&M Hennes & Mauritz AB (publ) was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
